body.heading: Where in the world is Mauritania?
paragraphs: Mauritania is a country in Western Africa, which is part of Africa.

body.heading: The capital city
paragraphs: The capital of Mauritania is Nouakchott.

body.heading: Words you might hear
paragraphs: The language you will hear most in Mauritania is Arabic.

body.heading: Money in your pocket
paragraphs: The money of Mauritania is the Mauritanian ouguiya.

body.heading: How big is Mauritania?
paragraphs: Mauritania covers about 1,031,000 square kilometres of land and inland water. That makes it about three times the size of Republic of the Congo.

body.heading: Two places we'd love to visit
paragraphs: Chinguetti is an ancient Sahara caravan town where families have kept libraries of handwritten books for centuries, as golden dunes creep up to its stone walls.
On the Atlantic coast, Banc d'Arguin is one of the world's great bird wetlands — millions of waders feed on its mudflats, and Imraguen fishers sail traditional lateen boats.
